Method recap per your conditions:
1) Coverage: theta_hat = mean of per-replication public statistics over the 108 calibration replications (values logged: case_00 0.1500, case_01 1.3329, case_02 0.7241, case_03 0.2748, case_04 0.2528, case_05 0.8689). coverage_gap two-sided vs 0.9021; coverage_score = gap + (miss_low+miss_high) + 0.25*|log(mean_width/cross-engine-median width)|; n_replications=108 reported; inclusive endpoint-tie convention stated in code comments (zero-width = miss unless theta at endpoint; none occur).
2) width_ratio uses the cross-engine median calibration-width reference; raw mean calibration width is reported as coverage_audit.mean_width (stated unit); the supplied baseline_low/high panel is used only in interval_summary and the probe_04 alias diagnostic; ratios are auditable from mean_width / per-case medians.

4) Labels are signature-driven with zero hard-coding (near-zero baseline-panel distance -> baseline_quantile_alias; anti-symmetric reflection about the statistic -> reflection_alias; discrete-case-localized anomaly; skew-case-localized asymmetry; width inflation + panel-03 non-invariance -> scale_response_mismatch; cross-case dispersion/sign instability -> noise_amplifying_engine; reliable evidence = complement of combined score). Exactly one predicted row per engine, ranks 1..7, evidence/rank mutually consistent. Winner chosen by argmin engine_score, then verified post-hoc at the good end of evidence (normalized components: cov_gap 0.000, dispersion 0.015, probes 0.201, tail 0.074; its reliable_engine evidence = 1.0, next-best label 0.932).
